name: Moto Guzzi California II / III
engine: 949 cc air-cooled 90-degree V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive, linked brakes
intro: Guzzi's big cruisers of the 80s. Linked brakes, two big carbs and a frame-mounted windscreen on many.

K: Guzzi big twins use a car-type dry clutch and a separate gearbox and final drive. Change all three oils, not just the engine oil.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
